releaseNotes: KabirUI 5.0: import from Nova Launcher, a simpler launcher with KabirAI removed, a privacy-friendly contact picker in Quick Search, and stability fixes.

changes.title: A simpler launcher
changes.detail: KabirAI assistant removed, with fewer permissions: no microphone or notification-posting permission.

changes.title: Quick Search
changes.detail: Call or message a contact through Android's picker, with no contacts permission.

changes.title: Stability and memory fixes
changes.detail: Fixes for widgets, wallpapers, backups, and downloads.

changes.title: Import from Nova Launcher
changes.detail: Import in Settings > Backup & transfer, with a safety backup and undo.
